data.title: 史黛菈 · 露天温泉水汽的耳鬓厮磨
data.description: 隐秘私人温泉中滚烫泉水漫过腰际。比基尼系带微散，湿透的深红长发紧贴在雪白发烫的背上。史黛菈从身后环住你的脖颈，将发烫的侧脸深深埋入你的颈间娇喘。
data.location: secluded private outdoor hot spring bath surrounded by rocks
data.action: embracing from behind in hot spring steam, wet crimson hair clinging to back, untied bikini strings, breathless moaning
data.lighting: steamy lantern mist illuminated by warm amber water lights
data.mood: steamy sensual immersion, flushed vulnerability, heated lovers embrace
data.promptProse: Embracing closely in a steamy natural hot spring, Stella clings tight with wet crimson hair and flushed skin under amber lanterns.
data.animaCaption: Stella embracing passionately in a steamy secluded hot spring at night.
